fields.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
fields.note: Core duty and proration are supported. The statement that the rate is published on the Rent Board's Security Deposit Interest & Calculator page is only loosely supported: the document refers readers to that page 'for more information' but does not say the rate is published there.
